sheets.title: ONE-LINE DIAGRAM INPUT DATA — Sheet 1 of 12
sheets.reading_notes: Overall one-line diagram showing utility service (Dominion Power at 34.5 kV), main substation switch (Westinghouse Type 345GS1500, 1200A, 34.5 kV), five step-down transformers (Sub B, Sub A, Sub C, Sub 6C as 1151 kVA each; Sub E1 as 1500 kVA), 38 kV gas switches on transformer primaries, and secondary bus distribution at 480V. Three main buses shown: E/W Sub B, E/W Sub A (with 3200A and 2400A main breakers), and Sub 6C. Shows beginning of 1600A bus duct (W) branch feeding Bus Duct A loads. ECB load (110A) shown on right branch. Drawing shows input data for all cable sizes, transformer impedances, and breaker ratings. Discrepancy between report narrative ('five 1151 KVA transformers') and drawing (Sub E1 is 1500 KVA) — flagged in corroboration.

sheets.title: ONE-LINE DIAGRAM INPUT DATA — Sheet 2 of 12
sheets.reading_notes: Continuation of one-line diagram showing 1600A Bus Duct (W) load distribution: MCC 14, PNL HVPB, MCC 7, E1 CC, MCC 12, MCC 8, MCC 9, MCC 10, NRM 4C/5C, MCC 11, MFM15, MM5CC, E5 GALA, E5 EXT, MFCRL PNL, and Bus Duct C with 800A MCB (MCC #13 via Bus Duct C sub-distribution). PNL A and PNL A1 (Chillers C1, C1-A and pumps). PNL FL with E-5 DC motor (500 hp shown). PNL PH. Multiple downstream MCCs, sub-panels, and transformers shown. Very complex distribution system consistent with large industrial chemical plant with multiple production areas (Extruders E1-E5, film line, gel machine, pulverizer, blowers, etc.). Plant lighting panels, level 1/2/3 panels (LVLP1/2/3), Lab Panel, Pilot Room MCC.

sheets.title: ONE-LINE DIAGRAM CONTINUATION — Sheets 3–12 of 12
sheets.reading_notes: Sheets 3–12 not rendered; they contain detailed branch circuit data for specific production areas, MCC downstream loads, and the remainder of the 12-sheet drawing set. Based on sheet 1–2 context, these sheets contain sub-distribution for the nine remaining substations and MCC sections covering chemical production equipment (extruders, bag house, conveyors, pneumatic blowers, chillers, lab equipment, pilot room). Not rendered due to drawing cap; key system-level facts fully captured from sheets 1–2 and the study report.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Drawing F-601 and Study Report Input Data section
conflict_flags.rationale: The narrative introduction overstates uniformity — all five are listed as '1151 KVA' but the Study Input Data and drawings clearly show Sub E1 is 1500 KVA (Z 6.2703% vs 5.7054% for others). The drawings and tabular data are more authoritative than the prose summary.
